blood_gender_swap_corrected_flag: True if blood_type/gender values were swapped in source and mechanically exchanged back (BR5)
test_results_medication_swap_corrected_f: True if test_results/medication values were swapped in source and mechanically exchanged back (BR5)
gender_unresolved_category_flag: True if gender value could not be confidently matched to a canonical value (dangerous-column exact-miss, or fuzzy score < 70)
blood_type_unresolved_category_flag: True if blood_type value could not be confidently matched to a canonical value (dangerous-column exact-miss, or fuzzy score < 70)
medical_condition_unresolved_category_fl: True if medical_condition value could not be confidently matched to a canonical value (dangerous-column exact-miss, or fuzzy score < 70)

medication_unresolved_category_flag: True if medication value could not be confidently matched to a canonical value (dangerous-column exact-miss, or fuzzy score < 70)
date_of_admission_unparseable_flag: True if date_of_admission raw value could not be parsed as any known date format (garbage/invalid, e.g. 0000-00-00, 31/31/2021)
date_of_admission_ambiguous_date_flag: True if date_of_admission was a slash/dash date where both MM/DD and DD/MM readings were calendar-valid, resolved via documented US business-context assumption (brief A3)
discharge_date_unparseable_flag: True if discharge_date raw value could not be parsed as any known date format (garbage/invalid, e.g. 0000-00-00, 31/31/2021)
discharge_date_ambiguous_date_flag: True if discharge_date was a slash/dash date where both MM/DD and DD/MM readings were calendar-valid, resolved via documented US business-context assumption (brief A3)
discharge_before_admission_flag: True if discharge_date < date_of_admission (physically impossible) - both dates present and parsed
billing_amount_sentinel_flag: True if billing_amount was the exact placeholder sentinel 999999 - treated as missing, not a real charge
age_sign_flag: True if age was negative in source (corrected via abs()) - BR1
billing_amount_sign_flag: True if billing_amount was negative in source (NOT corrected - flagged only) - BR2
length_of_stay_sign_flag: True if length_of_stay was negative in source (corrected via abs()) - BR3
room_number_sign_flag: True if room_number was negative in source (NOT corrected - flagged only) - N/A
age_domain_outlier_flag: True if age > 110 - implausible but not a generic 10x-median statistical outlier (median~52, so 10x rule would not catch this); domain-specific ceiling, flagged not corrected
billing_amount_decimal_typo_flag: True if billing_amount was corrected as a likely decimal-typo (value/10 or value/100 landed in the plausible band around the column median)
billing_amount_outlier_flag: True if billing_amount was flagged as a statistical outlier (>10x median, no divisor restored plausibility) or a d=1000 candidate (flagged, not corrected - more likely a unit mismatch)
age_decimal_typo_flag: True if age was corrected as a likely decimal-typo (value/10 or value/100 landed in the plausible band around the column median)
age_outlier_flag: True if age was flagged as a statistical outlier (>10x median, no divisor restored plausibility) or a d=1000 candidate (flagged, not corrected - more likely a unit mismatch)
room_number_decimal_typo_flag: True if room_number was corrected as a likely decimal-typo (value/10 or value/100 landed in the plausible band around the column median)
room_number_outlier_flag: True if room_number was flagged as a statistical outlier (>10x median, no divisor restored plausibility) or a d=1000 candidate (flagged, not corrected - more likely a unit mismatch)
length_of_stay_decimal_typo_flag: True if length_of_stay was corrected as a likely decimal-typo (value/10 or value/100 landed in the plausible band around the column median)
length_of_stay_outlier_flag: True if length_of_stay was flagged as a statistical outlier (>10x median, no divisor restored plausibility) or a d=1000 candidate (flagged, not corrected - more likely a unit mismatch)
length_of_stay_qa_mismatch_flag: True if cleaned length_of_stay disagrees with (discharge_date - date_of_admission) recomputed from cleaned dates - QA flag only, source length_of_stay value is NOT overwritten
near_duplicate_composite_key_flag: True if (name, date_of_admission, doctor, hospital) collides with another row - no true unique ID exists in source (brief A2), so this is FLAGGED for review only, never auto-removed
